title: ExternalObjectMap
description: Stable crosswalk between one source namespace and one canonical owner object.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

institution_id.description: Institution owning these data and their access policy.
institution_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

source_scope.description: Stable source parent scope or root sentinel.

external_key.description: Exact source identifier retained as an opaque value.

target_id.description: Canonical owner entity UUID, validated via owner adapter.

last_source_fingerprint.description: Canonical fingerprint of the most recent approved source input.

last_target_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the target at last successful promotion.

last_job_id.description: Successful transfer receipt that established this baseline.
last_job_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

state.description: Authoritative lifecycle state advanced only through owner commands.

revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision used for compare-and-swap.

x-invariants: Crosswalk updates require source authority and matching target baseline.
Multiple aliases may identify one native object, but one source tuple cannot identify multiple current targets.
